text:
rachel: starting quiet-window deploy for payments-service v3.2.0 (change window 01:00-02:30 UTC). enabling ff `payments_v3` at 1% -> 5% for 'canary-cohort'. release notes: https://redwood.internal/releases/payments-v3 :rocket:

deploy-bot: /deploy canary payments-service v3.2.0 initiated by @rachel. canary nodes: 2 us-east1. flag set: payments_v3_weight=1, cohort=canary-cohort.
omar: ack. preflight checks passed. safety limits: p95 <250ms, 5xx <0.5% absolute. auto-pin if breached.
lin: adding regional override: `eu-west1 max=3%` during quiet window. also mute debug logs for partners: `partner_debug=false`.
sre-bot: monitors attached. pause conditions: p95 +40% OR 5xx +0.4% absolute OR CPU>80% on canaries. alerts to #oncall.

(10m)
deploy-bot: canary at 1% stable. metrics: rps 70, p95 90ms, 5xx 0.02%. promoting to 5% for cohort after smoke checks. updating flag: payments_v3_weight 1 -> 5.
rachel: ramp plan: 5% (15m) -> 20% (30m) -> 60% (45m hold) -> 100% gradual. add a hard hold at 60% for 20m. any objections?
omar: +1. require manual ack at 60%. pin command ready:
```
# pin back to v3.1.4
deploy-bot pin payments-service v3.1.4 --reason "auto-pin-on-error"
```

lin: if regional pin hits, continue global ramp excluding that region. ops-bot, notify partners if region pinned.
ops-bot: will post partner notice automatically on regional pin and add opt-out instructions.

(20m later)
sre-bot: eu-west1 p95 rose to 320ms (baseline 200ms) but 5xx still <0.3%. not auto-pinning yet; keeping hold.
rachel: keep eu-west1 at 3% and collect traces to /runs/6199999999/traces.

(5m later)
sre-bot: eu-west1 5xx jumped to 0.6% in 2m. triggering regional pin.
deploy-bot: executing `deploy-bot pin payments-service v3.1.4 --region eu-west1 --reason "auto-pin-5xx"` -> SUCCESS. eu-west1 rolled back to v3.1.4. global canary now 5% excluding eu-west1.
omar: good. pausing global ramp for 15m while traces are reviewed. if other regions spike, we'll execute full rollback:
```
deploy-bot rollback payments-service --to v3.1.4 --scope global --reason "rollback-on-regression"
```
lin: traces saved and note added to release doc. ops-bot: partner notifications posted.
rachel: thanks team 1 will reopen once EU postmortem done and we decide to unpin or roll back."
